experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer
experience.note: OTA travel platform — search, rates, content, booking flows, and third-party hotel integrations.
bullets: Led system design, ticket breakdown, and architectural decisions across backend, DevOps, and frontend squads to streamline sprint delivery while conducting rigorous code reviews to enforce SOLID principles and clean architecture standards.
Reduced hotel list and rate fetch loading times on the client side from 2 minutes down to 10 seconds by refactoring caching layers, optimizing database queries, and streamlining API payloads.
Transformed multi-supplier hotel data ingestion, room mapping, and Meilisearch indexing pipelines from hours to mere seconds by leveraging asynchronous worker pools and chunked streaming generators.
Engineered custom data transformation algorithms to map complex third-party room rates, occupancy rules, and real-time hotel availability into unified internal domain models.
Fine-tuned Meilisearch typo-tolerance settings and custom ranking rules to deliver instant, highly relevant geo-search results for hotel names and destinations with minimal query overhead.

Re-architected Laravel Horizon worker pools and resource limits, drastically lowering CPU/memory consumption during peak sync workloads, while optimizing Docker multi-stage builds to significantly decrease container build and deployment times.

Designed and built a flexible integration layer using Strategy and Factory design patterns with Dependency Injection (DI), allowing rapid onboarding of third-party supplier rates and hotel content APIs without rewriting core search or booking logic.

Designed and rolled out a versioned RESTful HTTP API (V1 → V2) with parallel controllers/services and OpenAPI/Swagger specs, ensuring new feature releases ship on V2 without regressing existing V1 clients.
